changelog:
## 1.0.0
First Fabric 1.20.1 release — port of the Bedrock pack World Copies Everything.

Primeira versão Fabric 1.20.1 — port do pack Bedrock World Copies Everything.

- Infinite 16×16 repeating pattern
- Place / break / interact, portals, redstone, fluids, signs, item frames, explosions, mob clones
- Commands: /wce help, pause, resume, reset, status, verify
- Chat language: English, or Brazilian Portuguese if the game is set to pt_BR
